shuttle_notes: No port shuttles are provided or necessary as the cruise terminal sits directly at the edge of the historic city center.

metro_stations.name: Principe Metro Station
metro_stations.description: Short 6-minute walk from cruise terminal exit; connects to De Ferrari and Brignole.

rail_stations.name: Genova Piazza Principe Railway Station
rail_stations.description: Major rail junction with direct high-speed Frecciarossa and Intercity connections to Milan, Turin, Rome, and the Cinque Terre.

funiculars_and_elevators.name: Ascensore Castelletto Levante
funiculars_and_elevators.description: Historic public elevator in the city center providing panoramic hilltop viewpoints overlooking the harbor.

transit_options.route: Operates regularly between Airport and Genova Piazza Principe station
